items.title: Yang Hansen with his first career double-double: 12 PTS, 10 REB (2 OREB), 1 AST (2 TO), 1 STL in 26:09 played
items.author: inightyDAB
items.body_excerpt: Second-year Chinese center and 16th pick in the 2025 NBA draft, Yang Hansen got his first career double-double against the San Antonio Spurs: 12 points, 10 rebounds, 1 assist, and 1 steal in just over 26 minutes played. He shot 3/7 FG (42.9%), 1/3 3PT (33.3%), and 5/6 FT…

items.title: Based purely on minutes in preseason games Yang Hansen seems to have the edge over Branden Carlson in the third center battle for the non-Clingan/Timelord minutes. He looks so much more comfortable on the floor against NBA players than he did at any point last season.
